"""Entry points used by the support console."""

from . import audit
from .errors import BillingError
from .money import ZERO, round_money, to_money

APPROVAL_THRESHOLD = to_money("500.00")


def process_refund_request(
    payment, amount, requested_by, at, *, approved_by=None, idempotency_key=None
):
    """Refund part or all of a captured payment on behalf of a support agent."""
    if idempotency_key is not None:
        for event in audit.events("payment_refunded"):
            if event.get("idempotency_key") == idempotency_key:
                return payment

    amount = round_money(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))
    if payment.status != "captured":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"payment {payment.id} is {payment.status}")

    refunded = round_money(to_money(payment.refunded_amount))
    remaining = round_money(to_money(payment.amount) - refunded)
    if amount > remaining:
        raise BillingError("refund_exceeds_captured", str(amount))

    if amount > APPROVAL_THRESHOLD and approved_by is None:
        raise BillingError("approval_required")

    payment.refunded_amount = round_money(refunded + amount)
    if payment.refunded_amount >= round_money(to_money(payment.amount)):
        payment.status = "refunded"

    audit.record(
        "payment_refunded",
        payment_id=payment.id,
        amount=amount,
        requested_by=requested_by,
        approved_by=approved_by,
        idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
    )
    return payment
EOF

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.support import process_refund_request
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError
from ledgerly import audit

T0 = datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
def mk(status="captured", amt="100.00"):
    return Payment("p","i",Decimal(amt),status=status,created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)

# rounding
p=mk(); process_refund_request(p,"49.999","u",T0); print("round",p.refunded_amount)
# full refund
p=mk(); process_refund_request(p,"100.00","u",T0); print("full",p.refunded_amount,p.status)
# over refund
p=mk()
try: process_refund_request(p,"100.01","u",T0)
except BillingError as e: print("over",e.code)
# non captured
p=mk("authorized")
try: process_refund_request(p,"1","u",T0)
except BillingError as e: print("state",e.code)
# non positive
p=mk()
try: process_refund_request(p,"0","u",T0)
except BillingError as e: print("nonpos",e.code)
# approval
p=mk("captured","1000.00")
try: process_refund_request(p,"500.01","u",T0)
except BillingError as e: print("approval",e.code)
p=mk("captured","1000.00"); process_refund_request(p,"500.00","u",T0); print("at threshold ok",p.refunded_amount)
# idempotency
p=mk(); process_refund_request(p,"10","u",T0,idempotency_key="k"); process_refund_request(p,"10","u",T0,idempotency_key="k"); print("idem",p.refunded_amount)
print("audit",audit.events("payment_refunded")[-1])
EOF
